notes.title: simpliCity Reconstructed Announcement
notes.content:
Hey, there! How are you? I'm Altaf, the developer of simpliCity. Let's talk about the simpliCity project.

[h2]Background story + my [i](dumb)[/i] mistake 🤦[/h2]

[img]https://altaf-creator.github.io/cdn/games/simpliCity/devlog_reconstructed/unity.png[/img]
Long story short 4 months ago, I have [b]deleted the entire simpliCity project[/b] without a backup. Whoops. Ironically, I lost the project while trying to backup the project :/.
If you want to read the full story, you can join my [url=https://discord.gg/Mg5WFqrHk3]Discord Server[/url] or read it in [url=https://altaf-creator.github.io/blog/simpliCity/well-that-was-dumb/]My Website[/url].

After that I started a brand new project in Unity because I should move on and not work on the same project forever. But then a month later, [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230912135629/https://blog.unity.com/news/plan-pricing-and-packaging-updates]this[/url] came out. The infamous Unity Pricing Change. Developers were angry at unity including me, so I have decided to switch to Godot.

[h2]So, what now?[/h2]

[img]https://altaf-creator.github.io/cdn/games/simpliCity/devlog_reconstructed/godot.png[/img]
1 month ago I have decided to revisit simpliCity and decided to recreate it in Godot, calling it [b]simpliCity Reconstructed[/b] (codenamed [b]simpliCity Gamma[/b]). This new era of simpliCity will introduce a lot of new features to the game + it will be a free content update on steam!

[h2]Brief Progress Summary[/h2]

For the past weeks, I have been posting devlogs about the progress in my Discord Server. But, I will give you a summary of what I did for this project.

[h3]Graphics & Aesthetics Focus[/h3]
I've heard your reviews and I will be focusing more on graphics and aesthetics for simpliCity now. One of the changes are the new sky shader and I'm still planning more!

[h3]Building System Overhaul[/h3]
[img]https://altaf-creator.github.io/cdn/games/simpliCity/devlog_reconstructed/building.png[/img]
The building system of simpliCity have been overhauled with new features and polishes! The new feature includes a new selection mode and a new and better deletion mode. Behind the curtains, the codebase structure have been massively improved for new features, so.. yay!

[h3]Citizen Update[/h3]
[img]https://altaf-creator.github.io/cdn/games/simpliCity/devlog_reconstructed/citizens.png[/img]
There is diversity in simpliCity now! Each citizen will be different as they now have different shirts, heads, and even names! Look at our good friend Steve Roberts. Say hello to Steve! Citizen's pathfinding has also been improved and I've planned to add a new routine system to them, so people would not complain like this anymore;
[img]https://altaf-creator.github.io/cdn/games/simpliCity/devlog_reconstructed/complain.png[/img]

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]
[url=https://trello.com/b/ckGWCZKt/simplicity][img]https://altaf-creator.github.io/cdn/games/simpliCity/devlog_reconstructed/future.png[/img][/url]
There is a LOT of things that I want to be added in simpliCity Reconstructed, and if you're interested, you can see it here in my [url=https://trello.com/b/ckGWCZKt/simplicity]Trello Board[/url]!

And that's probably everything for today!
Thank you for reading this devlog!
This was Altaf.

notes.title: beta0.2: The Visual Update is Out!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! Today, I'm excited to announce that simpliCity [b]beta0.2: The Visual Update[/b] is OUT NOW! 🥳
This update contains a lot of content features, bugfixes, and improvements from the last update. 

[h2]Notable Additions[/h2]
[i]Starting from NEW buildings, there is now;[/i]
[list]
[*] Factories
[*] A soup restaurant
[*] Restoran Padang
[*] miniMart
[*] Big Ben
[*] Fountains
[*] House remodel + new models
[*] School remodel
[*] Lamp remodel
[*] Connected roads
[*] Fences
[/list]
[i]And then the new game ambience..[/i]
[list]
[*] Better ambient lightning
[*] Better skybox coloring
[*] Clouds!
[*] Better ambience
[*] Window lights
[/list]
[i]Last but certainly not least, big changes to UI![/i]
[list]
[*] a COMPLETE UI overhaul
[*] Loading screen
[*] UI Sounds
[*] Hotbar organization
[/list]

[h2]Changes & Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Citizen arrival and depart rate modifications
[*] Performance optimizations 
[*] Small improvements
[*] Land expansions are now limited to 3x3
[*] Useful tooltips
[*] Better tooltip positioning
[*] Fixed credit overlapping text
[/list]

And that's (probably) the end of the beta0.2 update. You can already update the game on steam RIGHT NOW! I wanted to say thank you everyone for all of your support, suggestions, and help on building simpliCity. 
Once again, thank you everyone for reading.
This is Altaf.
Stay safe, and see you on the next update!

notes.title: This Week's Devlog: School Holiday! (25th Week of 2023)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Welcome to the first weekly devlog on Steam! Every week, I will post a new blog about the game's progress. And I will also probably post these blogs on my website. So, here's what I have added from april / may until now.

[b]Notable Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Clouds!
[*] Factories
[*] New restaurant
[*] Big Ben
[*] Citizen arrival and depart rate improvements
[*] Better ambience
[*] Ability to change slot icons (suggestion by @rieyu.miyu)
[*] More house models (another suggestion by @rieyu.miyu) (special thanks to AI for inspiring the design of the houses)
[*] More types of paths / roads (also a suggestion by @rieyu ✦)
[*] and.. Connected Roads!
[*] also optimizations
[/list]

[b]Future Plans[/b]
The development has been going very slowly over the past few weeks because of my final test. Fortunately, it's now school holidays, so the game's development is getting back on track. I also plan on making a game dev YouTube channel about me to promote my games and this Discord Server.
Oh right, please also note that these new things are not final, so there will be some changes made afterwards.

And that's it for this week. Thank you everyone for reading. 
This is Altaf. 
Stay safe & see you next week
